laws.k: domestic-workers|AR|Law 26.844 on the Special Employment Regime for Private Household Personnel
laws.t: Law 26.844 on the Special Employment Regime for Private Household Personnel
laws.tp: Hours, rest, leave, minimum pay, social security and a dedicated labor tribunal.
laws.s2: Mengatur jam kerja, istirahat, cuti, upah minimum, jaminan sosial, dan pengadilan khusus perburuhan.

coded.vl: General labor law applies, or a dedicated statute grants its core rights
coded.n: Dedicated statute with rights equal to the general labor law.

coded.fn: Written contract in a language understood
coded.vl: Written contract required, no language rule
coded.n: Registration required; written contract not required.

coded.vl: Statutory minimum wage applies on the same terms as other workers
coded.n: Minimum pay set by the National Commission for Private Household Work.

coded.vl: At least monthly payment, documented, with limits on deductions or in-kind pay
Normal hours limited as for other workers
At least 24 consecutive hours, not replaceable by pay at the employer's request
Equal to or longer than for other workers

coded.fn: Keeping own identity and travel documents
coded.vl: General rule only, not specific to domestic workers or without a penalty
Worker may choose to live out; live-in accommodation must be decent and private
coded.n: Live-in or live-out; private and decent accommodation.

coded.vl: Worker may change employer without the employer's consent
coded.n: Migration status not tied to one employer.

coded.vl: Courts or labor tribunals on the same terms as other workers, or fee-free
coded.n: Labor tribunal for private household work.

coded.vl: Included in the general social security system, including maternity
coded.n: Social security, maternity and work injury.

coded.fn: Protection from abuse, harassment and violence

coded.vl: May form and join trade unions

dec.n: Reyes Aguilera, Daniela c/ Estado Nacional
dec.pe: A girl from Bolivia with a severe disability had lived in Argentina since 1999. She was refused a disability pension because foreigners needed 20 years of residence. The Supreme Court said that rule was unconstitutional.
dec.pi: Seorang anak perempuan dari Bolivia dengan disabilitas berat tinggal di Argentina sejak 1999. Ia ditolak pensiun disabilitas karena orang asing harus tinggal 20 tahun. Mahkamah Agung menyatakan aturan itu inkonstitusional.
